title: SS27 Kids' Woven Silhouette Direction
summary: Relaxed, easy-moving woven shapes for SS27 kidswear: dungarees, pleated and reversible dresses, sailor-collar tops, lightweight jackets and denim.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body: Fatamadrina lists relaxed shapes, dungarees, oversized T-shirts, pleated dresses and lightweight jackets as SS27 silhouettes<sup>[1]</sup>. At Playtime Paris, denim's "presence felt stronger and more diverse than in recent seasons", across everyday, workwear-inspired and coordinated styles; sailor collars ran through the show<sup>[2]</sup>. Poco Blush showed a loose, printed, reversible dress<sup>[3]</sup>. Future Snoops' Happenstance calls for "exaggerated silhouettes"<sup>[4]</sup>.

sections.heading: Shapes to lead with
sections.body:
- **Dungarees and short overalls** in denim and cotton twill.
- **Pleated and loose dresses**, including reversible styles.
- **Sailor-collar tops and dresses.**
- **Lightweight jackets:** denim, chore and overshirt shapes.
- **Relaxed shorts** with elastic backs and real pockets.

sections.heading: Shapes to watch
sections.body: Exaggerated collars and balloon shapes from Happenstance; use on one hero piece per drop.

products: - Dungarees, dresses, sailor tops, denim jackets and shorts.
design_implications:
- Easy dressing: wide neck openings, front fastenings for younger ages, adjustable straps on dungarees.
- Allow room for movement and growth.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist of young children's clothing, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, beads, shells and other decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Denim and dungarees are strong core buys; reversible dresses offer two looks for one price.
